code_commit_note: the SHA was recorded before the 2026-11-07 history rewrite and no longer resolves; the branch tip carrying the same tree is now c5b55a2, reached by a rebase to a2b8853 before the rewrite; the measured tree is unchanged

verdict.reason: the noul column does not move: the largest |delta| is 0.267 pp, 9% of the 3.0 pp resolution. Three-of-three positive fails on seed2; significant improvements 0/3. The honest phrase is 'did not resolve', not 'small improvement'.
verdict.resolution_basis: paired_power.detectable_delta(2995, 0.324, 0.80); the pre-registered denominator decided the outcome only in the sense that it rules out an improvement at this scale
verdict.secondary_note: the abstention-excluded variant (2,452 signal rows, resolution 3.4 pp) reaches the same conclusion: +0.408 / +0.082 / -0.163 pp. The pre-committed denominator did not decide the outcome.

heldout.basis: pre-registered frozen held-out, all rows, n=6,254 (170 choice rows without a label index dropped, same as the canonical gate)
heldout.realized_discordance_note: 25 / 1 / 10 changed noul predictions of 2,995. The paired-power helper is degenerate at 1 discordant pair (it returns 100 pp) and at 0.008 discordance it returns 0.5 pp; the planning 3.0 pp stays the operative bar and the realized figures are reported as a statement about the instrument.

jevbench.reading: JevBench has no base probabilities for any of its 231 ids (0/231 in the canonical precompute), and eval_listwise applies alpha only when a base term exists. Both the control and the arm are therefore scored by the raw head, with no base term and no alpha. The comparison is internally consistent (raw vs raw) but uses a different scoring rule from the held-out gate. The raw noul head is -18.9 / -32.4 / -21.6 pp on the 74-row column, significant on seed1; choice is +5.9 to +7.2 pp (ns); overall is 4.0-5.6 pp below the control. The alpha-weighted model was never evaluated on JevBench.
jevbench.methodological_gap: a JevBench veto measures the raw head, so it is blind to an arm whose only difference is the alpha-weighted combination. Computing base probabilities for the 231 JevBench items would close the gap, but it changes the control numbers and is a rule change that must be decided before a gate, not after one.

cost.heldout_choice_seed1: -1.098 pp, 15W/36L, p=0.0046: the only significant movement in the arm and it is negative
cost.heldout_score: negative on all three seeds (-2.398 / -2.137 / -0.407 pp, n=786), none individually significant

throughput.reading: 1.77x the epoch wall time for 1.86x the rows: per-row cost essentially unchanged, slightly lower. Training noul is close to free per row. Items per second is mix-dependent and is not the comparison.
throughput.lesson: the printed rate is cumulative (index/elapsed); a windowed rate is recovered exactly from two cumulative lines. A forward-count ratio is not a time ratio because the prefix is shared and the per-option suffix is a small part.
throughput.provenance_note: the noul rates and epoch time were measured on a tree containing commit 7bcff68 (skip the discarded cache-only prefix pass; right-pad the combined sequence to the existing bucket shapes). That commit is on branch feat/throughput-244 and on neither main nor feat/canonical-support, so the rate and the epoch time are not reproducible from the committed refs. The correctness numbers are unaffected.
